formula: changed IDs union(current closure minus exact complete 11295 prior support IDs) union explicitly invalidated old evidence
contextPolicy: Changed exchanges minimal current context, three rejected independent findings and all source/target/context mismatches. Other prior support is retained only after exact version checks; no blanket full-support reread.
removedDependencyReason: Prior 11295 support is retained version-wise wherever valid. Historical broader whole-conversation/concept selections not selected by these current finite predicates are recorded as removed from the required current closure, not deleted from prior coverage.
notIndependentAcceptance: This script only selects and verifies; retained findings/holds do not become clean, and all new delta judgments remain pending.
